l.i: Soari, Juris utriusque Doctori Eruditissimo, Joh. Morinus.

main_text.l: Retulit mihi R. P. Bertinus, & qui
quam in me sis propenso & amico animo.
gratulatus mihimetipsi, amari me à Vi-
bri: nihil amicitia tua mihi optatius
contingere poterat, aut laude tua hono-
volentia tua mihi conciliata est. Fœli-
cíter accidit, quod est in proverbio,
ἀ-μύνει ἡ πάγη[?]. Nam eorum diligentiâ
factum est, ut liber, quem, si ita loqui

page.notes: The initial R of "Retulit" is a large decorative letter, joined to the word. "possum" is partly blotted and read with [?]. The Greek proverb is split at the line end ("ἀ-" / "μύνει ἡ πάγη"); the accents on "πάγη" are uncertain. The printed long s appears as f in "fcripfit", "propenfo", "fuperfit", etc.; it is transcribed as a plain s. The final word "desideratissimam" continues in the catchword "simam" at the foot.
